extension.description: Automatically track movies and TV shows you watch in Kodi on your WeTrakr profile. Marks content as watched, syncs your viewing activity in real-time.
extension.news:
v1.3.5 - New WeTrakr look: new icon, fanart and logo in the login window.
v1.3.4 - Fewer requests while playing: the progress update goes every 5 minutes (and right after a seek) instead of every 30 seconds. Scrobbles, pauses and Now Playing work as before.
v1.3.3 - Login: waits for the network after Kodi starts and retries on its own, instead of showing "Could not connect to server". New Connect button in Settings > General. - Fix: a rejected token could reopen the login every 30 seconds while WeTrakr was unreachable.
